prompt: How i can make Italian Napoleon pizza with Egyptian ingredient
response: To make an Italian Napoleon pizza with Egyptian ingredients, start by preparing a simple pizza dough. Use a combination of Egyptian bread flour and regular flour for texture. Add a pinch of salt and a bit of sugar to balance the flavors. Let the dough rise, then flatten it out and add a layer of tomato sauce. Top with a mixture of Egyptian cheese and mozzarella, and finish with a sprinkle of cinnamon sugar. Bake it in a preheated oven to achieve the classic layered effect.
